title: Orchestration plan for SOC2/ISO rollouts, SSO adoption, and audit-log retention OKR mapping
creator: Asha Patel
description: Objective: create an executable orchestration plan that maps SOC2 and ISO certification milestones to SSO / SAML rollouts and audit-log retention policies, and ties these items directly to OKRs for H1 2026. Scope: core hosted API + Dedicated + Private delivery models; identity integrations (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace); audit-log collection, retention, and evidence automation for SOC2/ISO; rollout sequencing by customer segment (pilot, early access, GA). This ticket produces the master sequencing spreadsheet, gating criteria, release windows, and a runbook for incident-driven escalations.
acceptance_criteria: Master sequencing spreadsheet with per-milestone owners and dates is created and reviewed by stakeholders
Gating criteria defined for each milestone (evidence buckets, automated checks, manual verification steps)
Dependencies to engineering and security are enumerated and linked to ENG tickets
OKR mapping document associates each milestone to a measurable outcome and target metric
Runbook for escalation and rollback during rollouts is drafted and has at least two approvers (Security, PM)
tasks: Draft sequencing spreadsheet (owner: PM) - include pilot, EAP, GA windows
Define evidence buckets for SOC2/ISO (control owner list + automation feasibility)
Create SSO adoption plan: SAML metadata exchange steps, test accounts, and IDP onboarding checklist
Audit-log retention plan: per-tier retention (7/30/365) and API for exports to customer HSM/KMS
Create OKR mapping with measurable targets (e.g., % of customers with SSO, % of evidence automated)
Coordinate with ENG to create sub-tickets for telemetry exports and console retention UI
Align legal/compliance on evidence retention duration and data locality requirements
Build escalation matrix and contact list for rollout incidents
decision_log: 2026-02-16: Agreed to target 30-day retention for standard customers and 365-day retention as enterprise add-on after legal sign-off
2026-02-24: Chosen SAML-first approach; OAuth2 SSO deferred to post-GA due to scope
2026-03-02: Decided to automate evidence capture for 60% of SOC2 controls in phase 1; remaining controls will be manual evidence links
risks: Telemetry volume spike from audit logs may increase storage cost beyond current budget assumptions
SAML metadata edge-cases across different IDPs could delay customer onboarding
Legal sign-off for retention in APAC may add timeline risk
Dependency on ENG-4367 (KV cache telemetry plumbing) could block evidence automation work
links: ENG sub-ticket for telemetry export: ENG-4522
